headings.usage: Section titles, Doctor names, Modal headers

DoctorCard.description: A visually rich card for selecting a doctor.
DoctorCard.style: Glassmorphism effect on white background with pastel border on selection.
elements: Image: Circle or Rounded Square, large (w-24 h-24)
Specialty: Badge with pastel background (bg-secondary-light text-secondary-dark)
Interaction: Scale up slightly on hover, thick border-primary-main when selected

BookingCalendar.description: Customized Shadcn Calendar for date selection.
BookingCalendar.style: Clean, no grid lines, rounded selection indicators.

states.default: bg-white border border-neutral-200 text-neutral-text_primary hover:border-primary-main hover:text-primary-main transition-all
states.selected: bg-primary-main text-white border-primary-main shadow-md transform scale-105

BookingSummary.style: Dialog component with pastel accent header.
elements: Content: Summary of Doctor, Date, Time
Action: 'Confirm Booking' button (pill shaped, gradient bg)

structure: Grid: Use a 12-column grid logic. Left col (Doctor + Calendar) spans 8, Right col (Summary/Help) spans 4 on desktop.
Mobile: Stack everything vertically. Sticky bottom bar for 'Book Now' button if content is long.
layout_rules.white_space: Use generous padding (py-12) between sections to create a calm flow.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Refactor the existing DiaGyn page to use the new Pastel Medical theme.
2. Break down the large file into smaller components: `DoctorSelector`, `DateSelector`, `TimeSlotPicker`, `BookingSummary`.
3. Use the provided Unsplash images for the doctor profiles. Map them to the doctor data.

4. Implement the 'Pastel' color palette using Tailwind arbitrary values or by extending the tailwind config if necessary (prefer arbitrary values for speed if config is locked, but config extension is better for consistency).
5. Ensure the 'Book Appointment' flow feels like a wizard or a smooth single-page application.
6. Use `framer-motion` for smooth transitions between selection states (e.g., when a date is picked, the slots fade in).
7. CRITICAL: Maintain all existing logic for slot blocking and validation.
universal_guidelines: Avoid generic 'AI slop' designs. Be bold with spacing and softness.
No pure black (#000000). Use Slate-900 or similar.
Use 'sonner' for toast notifications on success/error.
